purpose: Read-only exact OSE Nikkei 225 Micro Futures market-data bridge using the user's existing Yuanta SPARK API entitlement when available.

instrument.exact_contract_requirement: Use the exact Yuanta StockCode for the active individual contract month. Never substitute a continuous symbol.
instrument.stock_code_discovery: Resolve dynamically from the current Yuanta FunctionList / verified contract resolver. Observed exact formats are JNU<YYMM> for day and JNUPM<YYMM> for night; examples must not be hardcoded.

validation_gates: Existing single-owner hub is checked before any standalone login attempt.
Exact JNU individual-month StockCode is dynamically resolved from current Yuanta vendor mapping/resolver.
Exact live quote has already been verified for OSE market 207 on an exact JNU contract; revalidate contract/session freshness each use.
GetStkTickDetail has already returned exact JNU current-day ticks; timestamp semantics remain subject to the frozen JNU freshness/evidence gates.
SubscribeStockTick must still receive matching MarketType=OSE and exact requested StockCode before streaming-tick promotion.
SubscribeFiveTickA must still return matching exact-contract nonzero depth before L2 promotion.
No trade/order API call is present in the bridge.

jpX_research_result.free_trial: OSE may offer one-month real-time market-data trial for internal evaluation; historical tick sample/trial may be available subject to conditions.

single_owner_rule: Never create a second Yuanta broker login while an existing verified quote owner is RUNNING/DEGRADED with startup_stage RUNNING. Consume its local snapshot/Parquet/control path read-only instead.
